comments.story: How the UK lost its shipbuilding industry
comments.text: Voted up just for the reference to Yes Prime Minister, one of the UK's best contributions to political education and entertainment. On the other hand, there's Sir Humphrey's opinion on Trident. "It's the nuclear deterrent Harrods would sell." [VIDEO]

comments.author: chadcmulligan
comments.story: The Era of the Trident Engine
comments.text: Thought the same - always think of this when I hear Trident - the nuclear Missile Harrods would sell [VIDEO]

comments.author: masterstatesman
comments.text: I love this part as well, when Sir Humphrey is arguing for Trident: [VIDEO] "In the world of nuclear missiles, it is the Savile Row suit, the Rolls Royce Corniche, the Chateau Lafite 1945. It is the nuclear missile Harrods would sell you."
